title: Sin Offerings
summary: Sin offerings addressed uncleanness, guilt, and the need for atonement before a holy God.
background: These sacrifices remind readers that sin disrupts fellowship and requires God’s appointed provision. The New Testament points beyond these offerings to Christ’s finished work.
teachingHelp: When teaching sin offerings, connect holiness, mercy, and the once-for-all sacrifice of Christ without flattening the Old Testament context.
